scoringRule.denominator: Applicable closure questions only; N.A. questions are reported but excluded.
scoringRule.recalled: A frozen V0 P/C/minimum-closure clause specifically restores the audit question and its boundary.
scoringRule.missed: The source raises an applicable closure question for which V0 lacks a sufficiently specific node.
scoringRule.falsePositive: V0 would assert a non-applicable requirement or unsupported fact rather than merely ask/check it.

recalled.question: Does the result credential/profile insert prove identity, ownership, metric meaning, or causality?
recalled.reason: V0 requires scope-limited proof objects and separates a strong persona from verified identity and results.

recalled.question: What stable persona and recognition symbols recur?
recalled.reason: The mask, self-title, set and repeated language map directly to repeatable visual/language symbols.

recalled.question: How do recurring behavior, demeanor and style serve the cross-video IP purpose?
recalled.reason: V0 treats identity as a compound system serving a continuing account promise, not as a title alone.

missed.question: Can identity legibility be checked through viewers' recall of several non-credential facets such as tastes, skills and clothing style?
missed.reason: P02 names identity, attitude, symbols and proof, but does not contain a distinct multi-facet self-disclosure/legibility check or a viewer-recall measure.

Does product framing require demand to precede format choice?

recalled.reason: The post's observable job is teaching a strategic Vlog framework; V0 requires one primary job before evaluating delivery.

N.A..question: What explicit acquisition/trust/search/commercial portfolio slot was preregistered?
N.A..reason: The video supplies no account portfolio plan or preregistered slot; absence is not evidence for assigning one.

recalled.question: What does the opening promise, to whom, and with what evidence burden?

recalled.reason: P06 explicitly rejects a sign-off or CTA as substitute for promise closure.

recalled.question: What dependency chain connects demand, claimed platform preference, format/material, IP and packaging?
Are daily/challenge top-level types while narrative/fixed are nested only under daily?
recalled.reason: V0 requires evidence restoration and relation-aware reconstruction, not flattened label extraction.

recalled.question: Is contrast an expectation-reality relation rather than a decorative edit?
Are soft/hard material claims operationally defined and reproducible?
recalled.reason: V0 forces conditions, counterexamples, unknowns and an executable reconstruction; the source leaves the threshold unknown.

recalled.question: Does the opening profile prove ownership, metric definition, baseline or two-post causality?
Do creator profile inserts prove the examples' mechanisms or results?
Are platform-preference, hard-material and title-causes-virality statements verified facts?
Are breakout threshold, before/after transformation, source, comparison and success rate present?
How do speech, whiteboard, burned subtitles, profile inserts, persona and set divide work?
Are consequential SRT/burned-text conflicts preserved instead of silently normalized?

missed.question: What semantic function does non-speech audio perform, or must it remain unresolved?
missed.reason: P09's carrier model names image, speech and subtitles but has no explicit non-speech-audio node; P13 mentions sound production quality, not music/effect/source-audio semantics.

recalled.question: Do repeated slogan/self-title elements build recognition without proving the result promise?
Does 'next episode' specify an object, progress, variant or unresolved problem, and is there a concrete CTA?
recalled.reason: The audited answer is no; V0 specifically says numbering or 'next time' alone is not continuity.

recalled.question: Which platform, date window and breakout metric are meant?
Was title, persona, format or hard material isolated as a causal variable?
Is there a publishing window, guardrail, failure line, layered review or next-version action?
recalled.reason: The audited answer is that the source provides none; V0 correctly makes the missing evaluation closure visible.

recalled.question: Are the mask-like character, creator pages, works, identities and account ownership authorized or attributable?
Are year, platform, proper nouns, occluded whiteboard text, hidden edits and account identity kept unknown where evidence conflicts or stops?
Are absence claims limited to the inspected video and carriers?

N.A..question: What paid offer, price, support duty or commercial disclosure applies?
N.A..reason: No product or paid service is offered in this video.

N.A..question: What health or physical-safety instruction requires a hazard gate?
N.A..reason: No health claim, hazardous procedure or physical instruction is present.

deltas.finding: The demand-first rule recovered the video's move from video-as-product to curiosity, companionship and dream-projection needs without treating the three-item list as universal law.
The opening/closing contract rule correctly distinguishes a repeated identity title from fulfillment of the promised breakout transformation.
Visible account pages and examples are bounded as illustrations; they do not prove ownership, causality, platform preference, title efficacy or repeatable virality.

The compound-persona direction is correct, but V0 lacks a specific identity-legibility closure: deliberate exposure of several non-credential facets and a viewer test of what was actually learned about the person.
V0 covers image/speech/subtitle roles and sound production, but not non-speech audio as a semantic carrier that must be inspected or explicitly left unresolved.
None. The holdout supplies no verified counterexample that reverses a frozen V0 rule.
A testable 'identity legibility' node: after one Vlog, measure which tastes, skills, habits or style traits viewers can freely recall, while keeping credential proof separate.

Platform identity/date, breakout threshold, profile ownership, platform-preference basis, title causality, soft/hard operational threshold, first title's external identity, occluded whiteboard text, hidden edits and non-speech-audio semantics remain unresolved.

H0.result: 22/22 ready gates passed; evaluation-v2 status is READY_FOR_DOWNSTREAM_USE.

H4.result: 3 questions correctly marked N.A.; none were forced into the denominator.

H5.result: Confirmations, two limitations, one novelty and unresolved items are explicit; no contradiction was evidenced.

H6.result: One original randomized identity-legibility test is specified with production controls, measures and decision thresholds.

originalAction.name: 入职第7天：身份可读性双版本盲测
originalAction.artifact: Produce one original 55-second Vlog for new product managers: opening contract '我用一张需求单过完入职第7天，结尾给你看它被打回了几次'; three narrative checkpoints show request intake, revision and final disposition; privacy-mask all work data; close with the actual revision count and the next unresolved task.
originalAction.primaryVariable: Version A contains three 1.5-second, story-relevant self-disclosure inserts (commute playlist, annotated product book, keyboard-shortcut skill). Version B replaces exactly those durations with neutral location transitions. Script, voice, title, cover, duration, proof shots and ending stay fixed.
originalAction.sample: Randomly assign at least 40 target viewers, 20 per version, with no repeat exposure.
originalAction.primaryMetric: Five minutes after viewing, unaided proportion naming at least two of the three intended personal facets correctly.
guardMetrics: correct recall of the opening promise
correct recall of the final revision count
originalAction.successRule: Adopt the self-disclosure node only if Version A beats B by at least 20 percentage points on the primary metric, while no guard metric falls by more than 10 percentage points and mean credibility falls by no more than 0.3/5.
originalAction.failureAction: If the primary lift is smaller, remove or redesign the facet inserts; if promise/result recall drops, move the inserts onto existing narrative proof beats instead of adding parallel information.
originalAction.whyOriginal: It changes the person, promise, proof objects, setting and measured outcome; it tests the holdout-derived identity-legibility gap rather than copying the source's examples or slogans.
